runner: headless Chrome (SwiftShader) over CDP; real mouse / keyboard input

steps.name: intro
steps.action: Open the app in an empty browser profile
steps.expected: A typographic introduction with a plant field drawn from the model's real instances; one Start

steps.name: choose-landscape
steps.action: Click Start
steps.expected: Three landscape cards in one axonometric language; only Detroit (real model) can be entered; the other two are 'Planned'

steps.name: enter-detroit
steps.action: Click the Detroit card
steps.expected: Short transition into the Design workspace at Define; no resume prompt (empty profile)

steps.name: strategy-proposed
steps.action: Click the starter intent “Keep the meadows, … matrix along the main garden paths, early flowers beneath trees, pollinators all season”
steps.expected: A whole-site strategy drawn on the map: ≥ 3 zones (role · system · logic) over ≥ 15 Main Garden beds, meadows kept, Rules mode stated, trees rule reported honestly

actual.method: Rules mode — explicit rules over your words and the site (no language model)

steps.name: strategy-confirmed
steps.action: Click “Confirm strategy”
steps.expected: One undoable confirmation; Continue enabled; no bed-by-bed confirmation

steps.name: structure-preview-all
steps.action: Click Continue to Structure
steps.expected: Every bed of the strategy previewed at once (curved bands along the paths, honeycomb, organic), no bed fails

steps.name: structure-size
steps.action: Drag the Matrix-beds cell-width slider (real click on the track)
steps.expected: The zone's real candidates change (cell count), only that zone is recomputed

steps.name: structure-guide-curve
steps.action: “Draw a guide curve” for the path zone, click 4 points across the beds, “Use this curve”
steps.expected: Bands of the zone follow the drawn curve (distance bands from it), clipped by each bed

actual.note: Curved bands: distance bands from your guide curve; segments cut perpendicular to the guide.

steps.name: structure-confirm-all
steps.action: Click “Confirm N beds”
steps.expected: All beds structured in ONE undo step

steps.name: structure-refine-bed
steps.action: Click bed A1 on the canvas, choose Organic, confirm
steps.expected: Only A1 changes (local refinement); every other bed keeps its cell ids

steps.name: mix-palette
steps.action: Continue to Compose
steps.expected: A visual palette: each mix card shows a plan patch from the fill engine, a section, a phenology ribbon, its system; recipes from the Detroit legends (base + overlay + drift)

steps.name: mix-compare
steps.action: Click “compare” on two mix cards
steps.expected: Same-scale plan patches, sections and ribbons side by side

steps.name: brush-hover
steps.action: Click the Matrix mix card, move the mouse over bed B1 (no button)
steps.expected: Brush on (HUD), ghost candidates under the cursor, nothing written

steps.name: brush-live-stroke
steps.action: Press on B1, drag across the walk to B2 (25 real mouse moves), release
steps.expected: Plants appear and increase WHILE the button is held (frames + staged counts, nothing committed); on release the same plants are committed in one undo step; no plant on the walk or outside a cell

steps.name: brush-esc-cancel
steps.action: Drag over B3N → B3S, press Esc before releasing
steps.expected: Staged plants discarded; design unchanged

steps.name: brush-undo-redo
steps.action: Click Undo, then Redo (dock)
steps.expected: The whole stroke disappears and comes back identically

steps.name: brush-repeat-no-stacking
steps.action: Drag the same stroke again
steps.expected: Same world-anchored candidates: nothing added, nothing stacked

steps.name: brush-zoom-metric
steps.action: Stroke B4 → B5 at two zoom levels (undo between)
steps.expected: The brush is in metres: at both zooms plants lie within the same radius of the stroke

steps.name: brush-fast-drag
steps.action: A fast drag: only 3 mouse moves over ~25 m
steps.expected: The stroke is densified (step ≤ radius / 2): no gap along the path inside the beds

steps.name: brush-overlay-keeps-matrix
steps.action: Choose Colour blocks, switch the HUD to Overlay only, drag over the painted matrix
steps.expected: Emergents of the new mix appear over the existing matrix; the matrix (base) is kept exactly

steps.name: cell-fill
steps.action: Esc (brush off), click a C3 cell, “Fill with Dropseed matrix” in the inspector
steps.expected: The whole cell is filled by the same engine (whole-cell fragment, target vs placed shown)

steps.name: freeze
steps.action: “Freeze” the filled cell, then brush across it
steps.expected: The frozen cell keeps every plant

steps.name: auto-compose
steps.action: Click “Auto compose”, check the dashed proposal, Accept
steps.expected: Unplanted cells get mixes by the documented greedy rule; previewed first; one undo step

steps.name: shared-mix-edit
steps.action: Open the Matrix recipe, set its emergent layer to 1.4 / m², read the impact, “Update all”
steps.expected: Impact previewed (cells, plants before → after, frozen excluded); only fragments of this mix re-filled

steps.name: axo-same-instances
steps.action: Click Axo in the dock
steps.expected: The 3D view shows the same plant instances (model rows = project plants)

steps.name: explore-performance
steps.action: Plan, then Continue to Explore
steps.expected: Performance view: 1 m pixels of flowering plants / m² for the month, unknown hatched, continuity links, short legend; timeline in the dock

steps.name: regions-distribution
steps.action: Fill bed A2 with Colour blocks and A4 with Organic groups (select cells, Fill), shift-click both beds in Explore, June
steps.expected: Similar area and plant totals; presence can be similar, but flowering counts / fraction / per m² differ; unknown apart

steps.name: illustrative-off
steps.action: Define → untick the Illustrative layer, read June, tick it again
steps.expected: Without the teaching layer the unknown count rises and known flowering falls — shown as unknown, never as 0

steps.name: views-and-months
steps.action: Dock: Plan → Axo → Plan → Diagram (structure · mix · arrangement) → Performance; months Apr / Jul / Sep; Play, Pause
steps.expected: Real visual differences, same coordinates; camera target kept; views and timeline never change the design

steps.name: issue-back-to-compose
steps.action: In “To look at”, click “Repaint these cells”, paint, return to Explore
steps.expected: Compose opens with the issue's cells selected; the change is recomputed in Explore

steps.name: knowledge-lenses
steps.action: Knowledge tab → Ecological association lens, click a plant node, click a line; Matrix, Table; Spatial function lens
steps.expected: X · Plants → Z → Y network from real relations; focus dims the rest; a line shows its evidence; Matrix / Table read the same edges; V4.3 spatial-function relations are back

steps.name: knowledge-record
steps.action: Add a project record (flowering 6–7) for a placed plant with unknown flowering → preview the effect → Apply → Back to the design
steps.expected: The effect (metrics before → after) is shown before applying; after Apply the unknown count falls; the design (stage, selection) is where it was

preview: Plant positions and mixes stay as they are; Rules suggestions will use the new value.

steps.name: save-compare
steps.action: “Save this option”, change the design, “compare”
steps.expected: Both options compared with the same definitions, month and scope (recomputed now)

steps.name: export
steps.action: Export JSON (read)
steps.expected: Instances with x / y / z, slot, fragment and mix version; layered recipes; frozen cells; assumptions

steps.name: reload-resume
steps.action: Reload the page (resume)
steps.expected: Plants (ids, x, y), fragments, locks, strategy and stage restored

steps.name: narrow-820
steps.action: Resize to 820 × 1000
steps.expected: Canvas above, panel below, dock in two rows; no horizontal overflow
